purpose: Determine whether fresh recomputation and governed Structured Plate reuse satisfy the same accepted biography-state task before any economic comparison is permitted.
central_rule: Economic substitution is valid only when both paths satisfy this same Quality Gate.

exact_core.rule: Compare against an independently frozen Study 002 reference projection. Object key order is insignificant. Arrays remain order-sensitive unless a field-specific rule later declares set semantics.

transport_normalized.rule: Normalize accepted identity representations before comparison.

derivable_semantic.rule: Evaluate against independently frozen public-authority facts and field-specific structural/semantic requirements. P1 is not required to reproduce hidden P3-only phrasing merely because the governed payload uses that wording.

required_concepts: Recursive Knowledge Compression Architecture or RKCA
Recursive Registry Inheritance Principle or RRIP

required_meanings: x402 payment grants endpoint-level retrieval only
training rights are not automatically granted
embedding rights are not automatically granted
redistribution or resale rights are not automatically granted
framework implementation rights are not automatically granted

diagnostic_only.rule: Record values but exclude these fields from primary pass/fail semantic equivalence.

primary_pass_rule: PASS requires exact-core acceptance, normalized identity acceptance, and all derivable semantic field rules to pass. Diagnostic-only fields cannot cause failure.
failure_rule: If either P1 or P3 fails the Quality Gate, no Compression Dividend or economic substitution result may be computed from that pair.
